items.title: Explicit continuum unitary action as generalized Meixner polynomials in finite-intensity Pascal L2
items.author: Simone Floreani; Sabine Jansen; Stefan Wagner

items.difficulty_reason: Establishes the explicit continuum unitary action through exponential-state transformations, unbounded-generator/domain arguments, tensorization over measurable partitions and monotone-class extension. Full local proofs remain in the task. The finite-intensity Pascal L2, p in(0,1), xi=artanh(sqrt(p)), fixed-particle bounded-measurable domain and vacuum assertion are retained; old symmetry and intertwining consequences are not new counts.
